title: Russia–Ukraine war
summary: The full-scale war is in its fifth year. Both sides are trading mass strikes on each other's energy systems as winter nears, a US-announced energy ceasefire has collapsed, and Washington has paused new sanctions on Russia for up to 60 days.

background.text: Trump announces an 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine without published terms.
Trump waives nearly all measures in the Graham Act, a day before they were to take effect.
